a: Team sync: Settings > Shared accounts. Rust team_sync.rs encrypts (team passphrase -> PBKDF2 -> AES-GCM) and stores in Firestore team/{meta,marker,data}; polls only team/marker each minute. Secrets shared = Credential Manager services in SHARED_SERVICES plus SHARED_FILES (video-sources.json); add new shared secrets there. Workspace parts (brands, accounts, channels, categories, setup) are 3-way merged in src/workspaceSync.ts; App.tsx serialises saves and syncs (exclusive queue) and replays stale saves with mergeWorkspaces. Approved review posts are claimed with claim_review_post so only one PC publishes. Release-installed apps (SOCIALSPACE_RELEASE_CHANNEL, .github/workflows/release.yml) update from GitHub releases.
